title: Claude models moved to Vertex without changing the API contract
summary:
A compatibility-focused day: Claude moved to Vertex, builder workflows gained visibility, and chat picked up another resident.

Claude and claude-large now run through Google Vertex AI, with strict OpenAI-compatible behavior and a sensible max_tokens default added alongside the move. Same models, fewer provider-shaped surprises.

The project-manager workflow got an upgrade, while Myceli.AI gained a KPI dashboard for seeing what its work is doing instead of consulting the vibes.

ChatPUA was added to chat, and the latest Instagram post landed to keep the public garden watered.
